verification_method: Prior exact-hash recovery report; raw CSV unavailable in this fresh checkout.

claim: The modelling table contains 151031 rows and 840 stations.
verification_method: Historical manifest and prior integration tests; ignored processed CSV unavailable.
boundary: Excludes missing and qualified DO targets under documented rules.

claim: The V3 development population contains 119690 rows and 672 stations.
verification_method: Recomputed from frozen V3 row-level predictions.
boundary: Development population only.

claim: V3 baseline and selected-procedure observations have identical membership and outer folds.
verification_method: Exact row identity/date/target/fold comparison.
boundary: Does not establish independence from earlier model development.

claim: No station appears in more than one V3 outer validation fold.
verification_method: Station-to-fold cardinality check.
boundary: Station separation does not remove temporal dependence within station.

claim: Preprocessing is fitted within training boundaries.
verification_method: Code inspection and synthetic boundary tests.
boundary: Historical execution provenance is additionally recorded by manifests.

claim: V3 lowers low-DO MAE from 3.3235 to 2.3613 mg/L.
verification_method: Independent metric recomputation from frozen predictions.
boundary: Nested station-grouped development CV.

claim: V3 increases low-DO recall from 0.1293 to 0.3641.
verification_method: Confusion matrix recomputation using measured and predicted DO < 4 mg/L.
boundary: Nested station-grouped development CV.

claim: V3 worsens overall MAE from 0.8797 to 0.9516 mg/L and raises false positives from 26 to 219.
verification_method: Metric and confusion reconstruction.
boundary: Must accompany any V3 improvement claim.

claim: Weighting alone caused the full V3 outer-fold difference.
verification_method: Baseline and selected procedure differ in model family and hyperparameters as well as weight.
boundary: Matched inner-fold comparisons only support exploratory attribution.

claim: Matched inner-fold evidence supports weighting as a contributor.
verification_method: 640 architecture/parameter/fold-matched weight-1 versus weight-8 pairs.
boundary: Dependent reused inner folds; not an outer-level causal estimate.

claim: V4 classifier recall is 0.9222 with precision 0.0684 and 9517 false positives.
verification_method: Confusion reconstruction from frozen V4 predictions.
boundary: Exploratory development-only classifier at fixed threshold 0.5.

claim: V4 is a direct performance upgrade over V3.
verification_method: Objectives decision functions selection protocols and timing differ.
boundary: V3 and V4 are not a controlled improvement comparison.

claim: There are 758 low-DO rows at 115 stations; 47 stations contain one event.
verification_method: Recomputed from unique V3 baseline identities.
boundary: Rows within station are dependent.

claim: The event-share HHI is 0.0337, equivalent to 29.7 equally represented stations.
verification_method: Descriptive concentration calculation from station event shares.
boundary: Effective count is a concentration summary not an independent sample size.

claim: Later calendar bands have lower descriptive OOF MAE than earlier bands.
verification_method: Fixed time bands with pooled and 173-station balanced-panel summaries.
boundary: Not prospective temporal validation; models use other rows across all eras.

claim: Changing station composition alone explains the time-band MAE pattern.
verification_method: Direction persists in same-station macro sensitivity analysis.
boundary: Other case-mix and monitoring changes remain possible.

claim: V3 selected becomes lower-cost than baseline when C_FN/C_FP exceeds 1.084.
verification_method: Algebraic crossing from FN/FP counts.
boundary: Costs are hypothetical and not policy recommendations.

claim: V4 classifier becomes lower-cost than V3 selected when C_FN/C_FP exceeds 21.981.
verification_method: Algebraic crossing from FN/FP counts.

claim: The system is validated for deployment or environmental warning use.
verification_method: No external confirmation decision policy or operational calibration.
boundary: Research prototype only.

claim: The model forecasts future dissolved oxygen.
verification_method: Predictors are contemporaneous measurements and date context.
boundary: It estimates current measured DO.

claim: V1/V2 grouped temporal basin and repeated-split results are robustness evidence.

claim: The applicant independently authored and verified the technical work described.

boundary: Do not use first-person contribution claims until confirmed.

claim: Sampling intensity alone is insufficient under the specified independent common-rate benchmark.

claim: The concentration contrast persists after excluding stations with fewer than 10 30 or 100 observations.
